title: Hable Usted --- The Polite Command
label: ch:command-usted
canDo: I can give a formal command and say why the usted form is the polite one.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C50-hable-usted: produce hable por favor and explain why the usted command is polite.
payoff.note: Usted is a worn-down title, so the order is aimed past the listener rather than at them -- and that indirectness IS the politeness.
